from.place: proof step (1): the projection map and its isomorphism property are local on an open cover of Y

title: Locality of the projection-formula isomorphism
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let E be an object of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) and K an object of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y) [def-pc-derived-category] [def-pc-derived-pullback] [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and let U_i be an open covering of Y. The canonical map Rf_*(E)\otimes_{\mathcal O_Y}^{\mathbb L}K\to Rf_*(E\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}^{\mathbb L}Lf^*K) is an isomorphism if and only if its restriction to each f^{-1}(U_i)\to U_i is an isomorphism.
